blockers: ENCODING FLAW: enriched_vecEA2_until (L484) and enriched_bypass_since (L586) encode positive between-zone SSNs as unbounded temporal operators at a single endpoint. Since at x gives y < x but not y > t. Until at x gives y > x but not y < t. The BracketFormula approach (which bounds witnesses to (t,x)) requires ordered witnesses for n >= 2, which is model-dependent. Requires architectural redesign.

encoding_flaw_analysis.root_cause: No single-endpoint temporal formula can express 'exists y strictly between t and x'. Formula.snce/Formula.untl evaluated at one point provide only one inequality bound on the witness.

current_encoding.until_direction: enriched_vecEA2_until (L484) uses BracketFormula.trivial (n=0) with positive between_tx SSNs encoded as Formula.snce char_y Formula.top in endpointRight. Backward direction works (bracket proves seg_guard on (t,x), endpointRight proves char_y at some y < x). Forward direction fails: Since witness y satisfies y < x but t < y is lost.
current_encoding.since_direction: enriched_bypass_since (L586) uses Formula.untl char_y Formula.top at x for positive between_xt SSNs. Gives y > x but not y < t. Same fundamental problem mirrored.

alternatives_tried_and_failed.approach: Direct proof via zone bridge lemmas
alternatives_tried_and_failed.why_failed: between_tx_temporal_iff requires exists y with t < y AND y < x AND predicates_match. Since witness gives y < x but not t < y.

alternatives_tried_and_failed.result: Successfully transported through HEq to get concrete endpointLeft/endpointRight/bracket hypotheses. Proved atoms case and all non-between_tx quantifier cases. Between_tx forward case remains stuck.
alternatives_tried_and_failed.why_failed: The between_tx case is genuinely unprovable with this encoding, not a proof technique issue.

alternatives_tried_and_failed.approach: Formula.snce char_y Formula.top).neg added to endpointLeft
alternatives_tried_and_failed.why_failed: Excludes y < t (via subinterval argument) but NOT y = t. The y = t case arises when the eq_t twin SSN has sub_nf.2 = true, and is not resolvable from temporal formulas alone.

alternatives_tried_and_failed.approach: Formula.snce char_y seg_guard_f (Since with seg_guard instead of top)
alternatives_tried_and_failed.why_failed: Same issue -- excludes y < t but not y = t.
Breaks the backward direction when t has the same predicate profile as the between_tx witness.

candidate_redesign_approaches.label: A: Nested Until in endpointLeft
candidate_redesign_approaches.description: Replace between_tx Since at x with a nested Until at t: Formula.untl (seg_guard_f) (char_y.and (Formula.untl seg_guard_f (char_1 nf_x))). This says 'seg_guard holds from t until y where char_y holds, then seg_guard holds from y until x where char_1(nf_x) holds.' Guarantees y in (t,x) by construction.
candidate_redesign_approaches.pros: Avoids witness ordering entirely. Stays within n=0 bracket framework. Forward direction straightforward (Until witness is in (t,x) by definition).
candidate_redesign_approaches.cons: x-sharing issue: each positive between_tx SSN produces an independent Until chain, and the innermost event (char_1 nf_x) references a specific x. If multiple SSNs produce different x values from unwinding, the construction breaks. Need to verify that the outer disjunction over nf_x values handles this correctly.
candidate_redesign_approaches.status: Not attempted in code. Identified as preferred approach.

candidate_redesign_approaches.label: B: BracketFormula k (k = number of positive between_tx SSNs)
candidate_redesign_approaches.description: Revert to using BracketFormula with k > 0, placing between_tx witnesses as bracket witnesses. IntervalPattern.holds guarantees all witnesses are strictly ordered in (t,x).
candidate_redesign_approaches.pros: Both bounds guaranteed by bracket semantics. Forward direction is straightforward (IntervalPattern.holds directly provides ordered witnesses).
candidate_redesign_approaches.cons: Backward direction requires a permutation lemma: given k unordered distinct witnesses in (t,x), show BracketFormula.holds for a sorted permutation. The lemma BracketFormula.holds_of_unordered_distinct was added then deleted (statement was incorrect). Requires sorting Fin n -> M.carrier for injective functions on linearly ordered types. Also reverts the Phase 2 architectural change.
candidate_redesign_approaches.status: Partially attempted. Permutation lemma statement was added to VecEAFormula.lean then deleted as incorrect.

backward_proof_technique.what_worked: Phase 2 backward proof uses: (1) BracketFormula.trivial with seg_guard proved via h_eval_quant contradiction for negative SSNs. (2) endpointRight proved via between_tx_temporal_iff + nf_depth0_char_formula_correct + Formula.snce witness construction. (3) Key lemma chain: between_tx_temporal_iff bridges (exists y, nf_eval) <-> (exists y, t<y AND y<x AND preds_match).
backward_proof_technique.reusable_for_redesign: The seg_guard universality argument and the zone bridge dispatch pattern are reusable regardless of which approach (A or B) is chosen. The endpointRight proof structure would change.
